newsitem.title: UK: TC Group to invest 10 mln stg in update plan.
newsitem.headline: TC Group to invest 10 mln stg in update plan.

text.p: British nursing home operator TC Group Plc said on Monday that its subsidiary Court Cavendish has been chosen as preferred provider for transfer of 16 residential homes and three day centres from Bedfordshire County Council.
The transfer would involve the TC Group to invest 10 million stg for undertaking a refurbishment programme to achieve registration standards.
The homes will be put into a separate firm which would be a wholly-owned subsidiary within the TC Group.
TC Group currently has 12,089 beds in 131 care homes, with a further 450 beds scheduled to open within the next six months.
